item.title: eBay bans airbag sales as concerns about faulty or counterfeit parts rise
item.description: eBay became the latest online retailer to ban the sale of airbags and many of their components. Aftermarket parts can be risky if they turn out to be fake or defective.

item.title: Judge orders Trump administration to restore journalists' access to White House
item.description: A federal judge ordered the Trump administration on Thursday to temporarily restore access to CNN, MS NOW and Politico, after they were banned from covering White House events by President Trump.
item.content:encoded:
A federal judge ordered the Trump administration on Thursday to temporarily restore access to CNN, MS NOW and Politico, after they were banned from covering White House events by President Trump.

item.title: Judge considers restoring journalists' access to White House after Trump's ban
item.description: Lawyers representing the White House and the three media outlets banned from the property sparred over the constitutional rights of journalists at a hearing in federal court Wednesday.

item.title: Will the Paramount-Warner Bros. Discovery merger be Hollywood's undoing?
item.description: Now that Paramount has an antitrust suit, the way is clear for a merger. But many say the deal will be the unmaking of Hollywood. NPR's Scott Detrow speaks with screenwriter and showrunner Mike Schur.

item.title: It's getting harder to afford rent in the U.S., even for middle-income families
item.description: Housing affordability challenges are spreading to higher income brackets, according to new research, which found one in five renters struggled last year to pay for their housing in full and on time.

item.title: DOJ defends White House media ban, urges court to reject lawsuit
item.description: The Department of Justice defended President Trump's recent media ban, arguing that reporting by CNN, MS Now and Politico on a wide range of issues jeopardized national security and spread falsehoods.

item.title: Major news outlets banned by Trump will have their day in court
item.description: CNN, MS NOW, and Politico are asking a federal judge to hold the president in check for what they say is a violation of their Constitutional rights simply because he doesn't like how they cover him.

item.title: How an 'AI freeze' could make big AI companies bigger and hurt smaller firms

item.title: A journalist once barred from the White House says this media ban is different
item.description: Jim Acosta has already been through a White House press-pass fight. Now, three news organizations are barred, and he says the press is showing solidarity that should have come sooner.
